Story & philosophy

From computer applications to product design.

I began with an MCA and an interest in building for the web—learning HTML, CSS, JavaScript and visual design while creating websites, posters and digital experiences.

My career changed when I joined Matrimony.com as a Web Designer and discovered product UI/UX as a discipline. What started with learning interfaces and Material Design grew into a career focused on understanding people, solving product problems and turning ideas into experiences that can be built.
